topic.label: Location and Place
topic.desc: Where something is: geographic coordinates, place names, addresses, distances and routes on Earth, and the regions and jurisdictions that a place falls in. Physical location; digital locations (where software runs) are in Environments and Deployment.

concepts: Named places on Earth (cities, mountains, parks, rivers, landmarks) and how gazetteers resolve a place name to coordinates and a unique place.
Distance between places (great-circle and travel distance), routes, bearings and travel time by mode.
Which country, state, county, city, time zone and legal jurisdiction a location falls in, and the boundaries that decide it.
Location beyond Earth: celestial coordinates, planetary surface coordinates and the reference frames used for the Moon, Mars and spacecraft.
skills: Gets the geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) of a place, address or landmark, and the place at given coordinates.
Resolves a place name to one place with its coordinates, type and country, and lists the alternatives when the name is ambiguous.
Finds places near a coordinate or place name within a radius, by type, with distances.
Computes great-circle distance and bearing between two coordinates or places, and travel distance when a route is known.
Plans a route between places for a travel mode and reports distance, time and waypoints.
Maps a location to its country, state, county, municipality and time zone, and names the authority that governs it.
Explains an administrative or legal boundary and which places fall on each side.
Explains surface coordinates and reference frames for the Moon, Mars and other bodies, and how they differ from Earth latitude and longitude.
mcp: Google Maps Platform MCP server: geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses and coordinates, place search and place details, distance matrix, elevation and directions.
Mapbox location MCP server: forward and reverse geocoding, points of interest search, directions and travel-time isochrones, static map images.
OpenStreetMap MCP server: geocode addresses and place names to coordinates, find nearby places, route between locations, explore neighborhoods from open map data.
